title: Keto Seafood & Smoked Fish Board
seo_title: Keto Seafood Board: Smoked Salmon, Shrimp & Shopping List
description: A keto seafood board for 6: smoked salmon, shrimp, cream cheese, goat cheese, brie, cucumbers, endive, eggs, avocado, capers and dill. About 8 g net carbs per serving.
hook: Smoked salmon, shrimp and bright lemon: a coastal keto board that feels light.
why: Seafood is close to zero carbs, so this board is built around smoked salmon and chilled shrimp, with cream cheese, goat cheese and brie to go with them.

Endive leaves, cucumbers and radishes carry the fish, and capers, dill, lemon and a little horseradish give it the sharp, fresh flavors seafood needs. Serve the seafood on a chilled platter. About 8 g net carbs per serving.

timeline.what: Take out the brie, cream cheese and goat cheese.
Slice the cucumber; separate the endive; cut the lemons.
Build the board; keep the seafood in the fridge.
Add the shrimp and salmon on ice or last. Serve.

faq.q: What goes on a seafood charcuterie board?
faq.a: Smoked salmon, cooked shrimp, cream cheese, a soft cheese, cucumbers, endive, hard-boiled eggs, avocado, capers, dill, lemon and horseradish.

faq.q: How do you keep seafood cold on a board?
faq.a: Set the shrimp and salmon on a platter over ice, or chill the platter first. Keep it out no more than 2 hours.
About 8 g net carbs per serving for 6.
